barCharacter: Scott Howl. Same job in the comedy: the sincere, dim, never-mean golden retriever jock who wants to help and be told he did good. Scott's 12 best from the corpus: (1) "Half of my friends are balls, actually! There's Ollie the volleyball, Fergus the golf ball, Troy the basketball - he's the best, he REALLY gets his head in the game..." (2) "I also used to have Barry the Beachball. He was cool, but then he fell in love with Tracy the Thumback. It wasn't a very healthy relationship." (3) "Cool, okay! I understood... a couple of those words, and I have no further questions. Let's do whatever you just suggested!" (4) "Yay, thank you! You're pretty cool for a god of torture!" (5) "Oh, did I say smart? I think I meant "best at coming up with weird plans." And I have a weird plan!" (6) "Wolf-Scott isn't as smart as Me-Scott!" (7) "GRRRR, WHO AM I? AM I HANDSOME?" (8) "Cool! Can we pretty-please borrow your cage?" (9) "GASP! That's crazy! I thought they were solved by smart people, but this makes way more sense!" (10) "Wow! You really think that will work? It just kinda looks like paper." (11) "Unless there are two guys here who sit on thrones of rusty spoons surrounded by a choir of screaming shadows." (12) "I know it's asking a lot, but... could you help me? You're, like, the smartest person I know!" OUR 12: (1) "One, hi, two, I'm Brock, three, you're lovely, four, we're ENGAGED!" (2) "She left at rep eighty. I'm still at eighty. Eighty. Eighty. I'm saving EIGHTY for her!" (3) "I skip seven. Always. Six, then eight. Nine years, nobody's noticed. Please don't make me do SEVEN!" (4) "I stopped counting once. On purpose. Somebody was sad at rep three. We stayed at THREE." (5) "{star} wants {card}. I'd bet my eggs. All twelve. Eleven. Ten. Okay, NINE eggs!" (6) "Protein bar for you! Ate it on the way! Here's the wrapper!" (7) "Can I spot you? I once spotted a man's soup. ZERO spills!" (8) "Cut who? I panicked and cut my own fur. Here. One tuft each. Nobody has to GO!" (9) "Easy! I eat forty eggs a day, so we're RICH in eggs, and eggs are money, I've decided!" (10) "You blinked! One! Two! You're SO good at blinking!" (11) "Sir! I made your bed! Then did forty pushups on it! Five stars? Forty-five stars?" (12) "Dash, buddy, Variant B was me clapping. It won." VERDICT. Voice: ours. Cover the names and the interrupting count is a sentence shape no one else in either cast owns; Scott is identified partly by openers (Bro, Cool!, Wow!, GASP!) that any jock could borrow. Construction: bar. Scott's lines put the turn last and stop ("It just kinda looks like paper.", "for a god of torture!"); Brock's best twelve are clean, but across the bank he stacks four to six exclamations and too often tacks a one-word verdict after the punch that names the joke ("So GENEROUS!", "Versatile man!", "Romance!"), and two openers explain the device outright. Quotable: tie. "I'm saving EIGHTY for her" and "we're ENGAGED" clip as well as Barry the Beachball, but Scott's ball friends build a world in two lines and nothing of Brock's does that. Not at least as good on all three, so the bar wins.

biggestGap: Kill the verdict label: in every line that lands its wrong fact and then adds '! Romance!', 'So GENEROUS!', 'Versatile man!', 'TEAMWORK!', 'Friends!' or 'SO + adjective', cut the label so the line ends on the fact ('Two lenses! One's for a friend!'), or replace it with a further, wronger conclusion that adds information the way 'and eggs are money, I've decided!' does. The bar never names the feeling after the punch; Brock does it in about twenty lines, and that, not the voice, is why he loses on construction.
